name: strict-current-wsl-v1
budget_basis: The512MiB declaration covers a conservative240MiB visible-file bound,192MiB+4KiB bounded temporary filesystems and at most64MiB report retention during teardown, with margin. It does not increase the shared20GiB cap or10GiB reserve.
reuse: Existing read-only rootfs1, CPython3.12.13, locked donor dependencies, LLVM18, patched Mesa9c5, original native audit/debugger tools and source/license records. Install only exact wheelb728b575 into a private overlay. No rootfs/environment/SDK copy, native compilation, source clone, dependency refresh or network fallback.
isolation: Use a private mount namespace and chroot with original roots bound read-only. Bounded writable mounts and copied collector executable stay in the registered run. Xvfb is an owned temporary child with recorded origin/readiness/exit. Copy only new raw reports out before the namespace exits; preserve every original report.
guards: Check writable guest filesystem and C:/D: backing capacity before registration and execution. Translate and preserve all coordinator protected/blocked paths in the guest registry, retaining prior guest protections. Bound child time and visible files; tolerate only files disappearing during sampling. No mutation of borrowed roots, dependencies, driver or runtime libraries.
checks: The same two selected strict workflows must pass all actual gates and share one exact installed environment fingerprint. Retain discovery and receipt-extension histories. No UNVERIFIED result becomes passing by relabelling. Current pytest phases, subject/profile joins, mandatory rows, CI and promotion remain separate.
cleanup: Await all owned children and namespace teardown. Retain originals, actual process receipts, source/licenses and failure reproducers, then inspect/apply the exact Windows-view cleanup plan using registry613; verify retained hashes and scratch absence. Preserve all original pinned origins.
